name: define-openspec-change
description: Define an OpenSpec change step by step (proposal, specs, design, test plan, approach review) with a cross-vendor review, then commit the change documents.

interface.shortDescription: Define an OpenSpec change step by step
interface.longDescription: Runs the proposal, specs, design, test-plan, and approach-review steps for an OpenSpec change in your own session, with a cross-vendor crosscheck review, then validates and commits the change documents.
